name: Wheatstate Wood Design, LLC
old_description: At Wheatstate Wood Design we strive to be the best in everything we do. From cabinetry to furniture, our commitment to exceptional craftsmanship ensures every piece is built to last. Your satisfaction is at the heart of what we do—we stand behind our work and are dedicated to exceeding your expectations with every project.
about: Wheatstate Wood Design, LLC is based in Hesston, Kansas. The company manufactures face-frame cabinetry and a range of handcrafted furniture including silverware buffets, dining tables, glider rockers, chairs, and outdoor furniture. Cabinets are built to custom specifications with a selection of premium wood species and finish options, and all pieces are produced using traditional woodworking methods. The business serves residential customers seeking custom cabinetry and furniture, though specific industry sectors or client names are not disclosed. Wheatstate Wood Design emphasizes a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and standing behind its work, aiming to exceed customer expectations on every project.
